storyCards.headline: The Rock Show: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
Blink-182's "The Rock Show" reached #71 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #71 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 9 weeks on the chart.

The Rock Show was released in 2001.

Album: Take Off Your Pants And Jacket (2001).
